scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ashok from LawWorld. Welcome! Today we explore how artificial intelligence is transforming legal research.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter smiling and speaking directly to camera against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: AI provides speed previously unimaginable. But speed without absolute accuracy is a dangerous legal gamble.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter presenting topic against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: Recently, top courts issued a major warning after an AI tool hallucinated fake legal precedents.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter speaking earnestly against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: The tribunal made a ruling using AI-generated citations that turned out to be completely unverified.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter analyzing legal research integrity against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: Fictional case laws were presented as facts, triggering a strict zero-tolerance policy from judges.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter explaining court policy against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: Judges reversed the decision, declaring efficiency can never replace expert human reasoning and discretion.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter detailing judicial decision against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: Legal standards remain non-negotiable. Integrity and professional diligence must always take absolute priority.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter emphasizing legal standards against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: The Bar Council was directed to issue strict guidelines for lawyers using digital AI assistants.
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter discussing legal guidelines against a solid plain grey studio background

scenes.dialogue: Technology empowers, but human discretion ensures justice. Hi, I am Ashok from LawWorld. Stay informed!
scenes.visual3D: Professional presenter concluding presentation warmly against a solid plain grey studio background
